records.run: global Schmidt law, normal disks + circumnuclear starbursts

axes.xDefinition: log10 disk-averaged gas surface density: HI+H2 for 61 normal spirals (mean within the RC2 radius), H2 only for 36 circumnuclear starbursts (mean within the central molecular disk, ~1 kpc); hydrogen only, constant N(H2)=2.8e20 Ico
axes.yDefinition: log10 disk-averaged SFR surface density (Halpha for the normal disks, FIR for the starbursts; Salpeter IMF 0.1-100 Msun)

representation.equation: Sigma_SFR = 2.5e-4 (Sigma_gas / 1 Msun pc^-2)^1.4 Msun yr^-1 kpc^-2, i.e. log Sigma_SFR = log10(2.5e-4) + 1.4 log Sigma_gas

scatter.meaning: 0.3 dex is the random error in SFRs and gas densities assumed by the paper for its formal fit errors; the dispersion of the composite sample about eq. 4 computed from Tables 1-2 is 0.36 dex rms

selection.population: 61 normal spiral galaxies plus 36 infrared-selected circumnuclear starbursts (galaxy-integrated / disk-averaged points)
selection.warning: Total-gas Schmidt law of the combined sample: the gas is HI+H2 for the normal disks but H2 alone for the starbursts (HI ignored), the CO-to-H2 factor is constant, and the SFR indicator differs between the two samples (Halpha vs FIR). x range is the span of the points tabulated in the paper's Tables 1 and 2, computed by the ingest script from the PostScript tables (the paper states no validity range for eq. 4). Not a resolved (sub-kpc) relation; do not compare with patch-scale simulation KS laws without the areaScale caveat.

definitions.areaScale: galaxy-integrated: disk-averaged within the RC2 radius (normal disks), central molecular disk of ~1 kpc (starbursts)
definitions.sfrIndicator: Halpha extinction-corrected by 1.1 mag, L(Ha)/1.26e41 erg/s (normal disks); L_FIR/2.2e43 erg/s (starbursts)
definitions.heliumIncluded: no (hydrogen only; the paper offsets its efficiency lines by 1.37 'to include helium and heavy elements')

records.notes: Equation (4) as published. Tables 1-2 parsed: 58 normal disks (log Sigma_gas, log Sigma_SFR) + 34 starbursts (log Sigma_H2, log Sigma_SFR) (92 points) OLS bisector, all points: slope 1.384, intercept -3.578 (paper: N=1.40+-0.05; eq. 4 intercept log10(2.5e-4)=-3.602); starbursts only: slope 1.362 (paper 1.40+-0.13) eq. 4 minus tabulated log Sigma_SFR: mean -0.004 dex, rms 0.355 dex (disks +0.024, starbursts -0.052) x span of the tabulated points: log Sigma_gas = 0.25..4.76
